    "initial state",

      "action": "clear all buffers and reset the state",

      "from": "initial state",
      "event": "MAIL",

      "to": "transaction in progress"
    },
    {
      "from": "transaction in progress",
      "event": "RCPT",
      "action": "appends its forward-path argument to the forward-path buffer",
      "to": "transaction in progress"
    },
    {
      "from": "transaction in progress",
      "event": "DATA",
      "action": "appends the mail data to the mail data buffer",
      "to": "transaction in progress"
    },
    {
      "from": "transaction in progress",
      "event": "<CRLF>.<CRLF>",
      "action": "process the stored mail transaction information, clear the buffers",
      "to": "no transaction in progress"
    },
    {
      "from": "transaction in progress",
      "event": "RSET",
      "action": "discard any stored sender, recipients, and mail data, and clear all buffers and state tables",
      "to": "no transaction in progress"
    },
    {
      "from": "transaction in progress",
      "event": "EHLO",
      "action": "clear all buffers and reset the state exactly as if a RSET command had been issued",
      "to": "initial state"
    },
    {
      "from": "initial state",
      "event": "NOOP",
      "action": "no effect",
      "to": "initial state"
    },
    {
      "from": "transaction in progress",
      "event": "NOOP",
      "action": "no effect",
      "to": "transaction in progress"
    },
    {
      "from": "initial state",
      "event": "QUIT",
      "action": "send a \"221 OK\" reply, and then close the transmission channel",
      "to": "initial state"
    },
    {
      "from": "transaction in progress",
      "event": "QUIT",
      "action": "send a \"221 OK\" reply, and then close the transmission channel",
      "to": "initial state"
    }
  ]
}
